entities.summary: Yves Le Saux is a French prelate of the Catholic Church who was bishop of Le Mans from 2009 to 2022. He has been appointed bishop of Annecy. He is a member of the Emmanuel Community. Yves Le Saux was a religious figures from Hennebont (b. 1960-12-24, Hennebont). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
